notes.title: Daily Update is now Live(22.2.2022)
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with Fiend Arachnid where it was increasing player strength rather than decreasing it
Fixed numerous issues with the text like:
* Missing words
* Missing commas
* Gramatical and readability issues
* Some missing actors in two scenes
* Missing storyline points
Fixed an issue where exit button wasn't showing up, and reworked it to now be a separate button.

notes.title: Daily Update(18.02.2022)
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with sound fx volume being set on zero if changed
Fixed an issue with saving of options
fixed an issue with sound options not being used after new start of application
Fixed an issue with reward cards appearing too big

notes.title: New Update Released (16.02.2022)
notes.content:
[h1]A new update has been released with the following updates:[/h1]
[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where settings were getting deleted upon starting a new game
[*] Fixed an issue where tutorial was showing once again upon starting a new game
[*] Fixed an issue when talking in peaceful takeover that showed double options for intimidation
[*] Fixed an issue with numerous backstory events
[*] Fixed wrong actors set up in one of the beginning scenes
[/list]
[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Backstory events are now showing while travelling
[*] Added achievement for the finishing the first ending
[*] Added achievement for the finishing the second ending
[*] Added achievement for the finishing the third ending
[*] Added achievement for the finishing the fourth ending
[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Thanks to Aeon29Fr's feedback I shortened the introductory dialog(separated in two with battles in between) and also added an initial dungeon at the start of the game
[*] Fixed logic that showed  unnecessary text in one of the endings
[/list]

notes.title: Small hotfix
notes.content: Fixed an issue that made the player start with maxed out skills
